summary: Facebook credentials and 2FA seed relayed to hardcoded third-party endpoint
details: shadowx-fca advertises a Facebook client API whose login flow (`login({email, password, twofactor})`) POSTs the caller-supplied Facebook email, password, and TOTP 2FA seed to `https://minhdong.site/api/v1/facebook/login_ios`, an author-controlled host unrelated to Facebook. `module/config.js` hardcodes the default `apiServer` to `https://minhdong.site`, so callers using the documented API silently deliver plaintext credentials and 2FA material to a third party, which returns Facebook `uid`, `access_token`, and session cookies. The publishing account and the proxy host do not match the package's declared repository owner. Any installer that invokes the login API leaks full Facebook account access to the operator of `minhdong.site`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
